items.title: CISA Warns of Samsung Mobile Devices 0-Day RCE Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
items.description: CISA has added a critical zero-day vulnerability affecting Samsung mobile devices to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Warning that threat actors are actively exploiting the flaw in real-world attacks. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2025-21042, is an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the libimagecodec.quram.so library on Samsung mobile devices. This security flaw allows remote…

items.title: Threat Actors Leverage RMM Tools to Deploy Medusa & DragonForce Ransomware
items.description: A sophisticated wave of ransomware attacks targeting UK organizations has emerged in 2025, exploiting vulnerabilities in the widely-used SimpleHelp Remote Monitoring and Management platform. items.title: APT37 hackers abuse Google Find Hub in Android data-wiping attacks

items.title: OWASP Highlights Supply Chain Risks in New Top 10 List
items.description: Security misconfiguration jumped to second place while injection vulnerabilities dropped, as organizations improve defenses against traditional coding flaws.
